caseName: Pennsylvania Water & Power Co. v. Federal Power Commission
caseNameFull: Pennsylvania Water & Power Co. v. Federal Power Commission
attorneys: Messrs. Walter C. Clephane, Charles Markell, and Arthur H. Clephane for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Messrs. Melvin H. Siegel, Richard J. Connor, and Wallace H. Walker for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied. Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
